# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We want participation in this project to be a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size,
disability, ethnicity, gender identity and expression, level of experience, nationality, personal appearance, race,
religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Our standards

Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment:

- being respectful and constructive, also when disagreeing,
- giving and accepting feedback gracefully,
- focusing on what is best for the project and its community.

Examples of unacceptable behavior:

- harassment, insults, derogatory comments and personal or political attacks,
- publishing other people's private information without their permission,
- other conduct that could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers are responsible for clarifying these standards and may remove, edit or reject comments, commits,
code, issues and other contributions that do not follow this Code of Conduct. Instances of unacceptable behavior can be
reported to the maintainer Marius Neuwirth at
[marius.neuwirth@isi.fraunhofer.de](mailto:[marius.neuwirth@isi.fraunhofer.de). All complaints will be reviewed
and treated confidentially.

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1, available at
[https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct.html](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct.html).
